annotations.title: Prepare an order for the person to confirm and pay (pilot)

description: PILOT. Turn a quote_id from get_quote into a checkout link for the PERSON: confirm_url on formada3d.com where they check the parts, price and their details, tick a confirmation box and pay themselves (card via Stripe, or invoice/PO). Creates NO order and takes NO payment; payment or card fields are refused. Only call it when the person asked you to prepare the order and agreed to share their name and email (person_asked_to_order: true). Link valid 24 h; a small number of prepared orders a day (over it: 429 daily_cap_reached with order_url, give the person that link). Track with checkout_status.

buyer.description: The person's own details, as they gave them. Pre-filled on our page; they can change them.

person_asked_to_order.description: true only if the person asked you to prepare this order and agreed to share their name and email.
